z-m-22-08.title: Ga lambobi uku waɗanda jimillarsu 6 ce, jimillar murabba'insu ma tabbatacciya ce?
z-m-22-08.goal: Ka nuna da misalan ƙaryatawa cewa jimillar murabba'ai ba ta kayyaduwa idan an san jimilla kawai, sannan ka yi amfani da furuci wajen tantance bayanin da zai kayyade ta.
z-m-22-08.material: Ga lambobi na ainihi a, b, c, an san cewa a+b+c=6. Mu duba ko wannan bayanin zai sa mu san ƙimar a²+b²+c², idan kuma ba haka ba, me kuma ake buƙata. (Ana karanta a² da ‘a a murabba'i’.)
z-m-22-08.thinking.2: Tantance ƙarin bayanin da ake buƙata
z-m-22-08.prereq.2: Kwarewar lissafa ƙimar furuci ta saka lambobi
z-m-22-08.s.s1.prompt: Ga lambobi na ainihi a, b, c, an san a+b+c=6 kawai. Menene ƙimar a²+b²+c²?
z-m-22-08.s.s1.hint.0: Zaɓi lambobi uku da jimillarsu 6, sannan ka lissafta a²+b²+c².
z-m-22-08.s.s1.hint.1: Zaɓi wani rukuni na lambobi uku, sannan ka kwatanta ko ƙima iri ɗaya ce ta fito.
z-m-22-08.s.s1.o.a: An kayyade ta 36. Ana iya samunta nan da nan ta ɗaga 6 zuwa murabba'i
z-m-22-08.s.s1.r.a: Ka ɗauka (a+b+c)² daidai yake da a²+b²+c². Ka duba waɗanne ƙarin sharuɗɗa suke bayyana idan ka buɗe (a+b+c)².
z-m-22-08.s.s1.o.b: An kayyade ta 12. Ma'auni shi ne ƙimar da aka samu idan aka raba 6 zuwa sassa uku daidai
z-m-22-08.s.s1.r.b: Ka duba yanayin a=b=c=2 kawai. Ka bincika ko wasu yanayi suna ba da ƙima iri ɗaya.
z-m-22-08.s.s1.o.c: Ba a kayyade ta ba. Ƙimar tana danganta da a, b, c
z-m-22-08.s.s1.r.c: Ka ga cewa ko jimilla ɗaya ce, jimillar murabba'ai na iya canzawa idan a, b, c sun canza.
z-m-22-08.s.s1.o.d: An kayyade ta, amma ba za a iya lissafa ta da bayanin da aka sani yanzu ba
z-m-22-08.s.s1.r.d: Idan an kayyade ta, ƙima iri ɗaya dole ta fito a kowane misali mai jimillar 6. Gwada misalai biyu.
z-m-22-08.s.s1.explain: Idan misalin jimillar 6 shi ne (2,2,2), to a²+b²+c²=12; idan kuma (6,0,0) ne, sai 36, saboda haka ƙimar ba ta kayyaduwa ta zama guda ɗaya.
z-m-22-08.s.s2.prompt: Ka ƙirƙiri misalai biyu na lambobi uku masu a+b+c=6 amma ƙimomin a²+b²+c² daban-daban, sannan ka nuna cewa ƙimar ba ta kayyaduwa.
z-m-22-08.s.s2.hint.0: Ka ƙirƙiri lambobi uku masu jimillar 6, lissafta jimillar murabba'insu, sannan ka rubuta su a tebur.
z-m-22-08.s.s2.hint.1: Zaɓi misalai biyu masu jimillar murabba'ai daban-daban.
z-m-22-08.s.s2.explain: Misali, (2,2,2) yana ba da 12, (6,0,0) yana ba da 36, (1,2,3) yana ba da 14, (4,1,1) kuma yana ba da 18. Ko da jimilla iri ɗaya ce, jimillar murabba'ai sun bambanta, saboda haka a+b+c=6 shi kaɗai ba ya kayyade ta. Misalai biyu da suka ba da ƙima iri ɗaya (misali (1,2,3) da (3,2,1)) ba a ƙirga su a matsayin misalai daban-daban ba.
z-m-22-08.s.s3.prompt: Baya ga a+b+c=6, waɗanne daga cikin bayanan nan idan aka sani za su kayyade ƙimar a²+b²+c² ta zama ƙima guda ɗaya? Zaɓi duk waɗanda suka dace.
z-m-22-08.s.s3.hint.0: Ga kowane bayani, nemo misalai biyu masu ƙimomin a²+b²+c² daban-daban ko da an san wannan bayanin.
z-m-22-08.s.s3.hint.1: Ka rubuta fasalin da aka buɗe na (a+b+c)², sannan ka duba wane bayani ne yake cike gurbin wannan furuci.
z-m-22-08.s.s3.r.a: Nemo misalin da abc iri ɗaya ne amma a²+b²+c² ya bambanta. (Misali, (6,0,0) da (3,3,0) duka suna da abc=0)
z-m-22-08.s.s3.r.b: Ka lura da alaƙarsa da a²+b²+c² a cikin fasalin da aka buɗe na (a+b+c)².
z-m-22-08.s.s3.r.c: Ka bincika ko a da b za su iya ci gaba da canzawa duk da cewa c tsayayye ne, yayin da suke cika a+b=6−c.
z-m-22-08.s.s3.r.d: Ka lissafta yadda a²+b²+c² da ab+bc+ca suke bayyana idan aka buɗe wannan furuci.
z-m-22-08.s.s3.r.e: Ka yi tunanin ko wannan sabon bayani ne, tun da yana aiki a kowane misali mai jimillar 6 tuni.
z-m-22-08.s.s3.explain: Tun da (a+b+c)²=a²+b²+c²+2(ab+bc+ca), idan ka san ab+bc+ca, to a²+b²+c²=36−2(ab+bc+ca) ya kayyadu. Tun da (a−b)²+(b−c)²+(c−a)²=3(a²+b²+c²)−36, sanin wannan ƙima ma yana kayyade shi. Ƙimar abc, ƙimar c, da ‘aƙalla 12’ ba sa kayyade ƙimar.

z-m-22-02.title: x⁴+4 ba shi da tushen ainihi, amma za a iya rubuta shi a matsayin samfur?
z-m-22-02.topic: Warware ƙaƙƙarfan ƙima (dangantakar tushe da abubuwan ƙaruwa, sauyawa ta hanyar ƙara da cire term)
z-m-22-02.goal: Tabbatar da furucin gama-gari 'idan babu tushe, ba za a iya warwarewa zuwa samfur ba' da misalin da ke karyata shi da takamaiman sauyi, sannan ka ƙirƙiri naka furuci da wannan hanyar za ta yi aiki a kansu.
z-m-22-02.material: Muna aiki ne a cikin inda coefficients na polynomial suke ainihin lambobi. Jihu ya ce, "Babu ainihin x da ke cika x⁴+4=0. Saboda haka ba za a iya warware x⁴+4 zuwa samfur ba." Mu bincika ko za mu yarda da furucin Jihu yadda yake. ('x⁴' ana karantawa 'x zuwa ƙarfin huɗu'.)
z-m-22-02.thinking.2: Ƙirƙiri misalan kanka da suka cika sharuddan

z-m-22-02.s.s1.prompt: Mu duba yadda hukunci game da furucin 'idan babu tushen ainihi, ba za a iya rubuta shi a matsayin samfur ba' yake canzawa yayin da sabon bayani ke shigowa.
z-m-22-02.s.s1.hint.0: Rubuta dabam ko kowane sabon bayani ya shafi 'furuci gama-gari' ko kuma 'x⁴+4 ɗin nan'.
z-m-22-02.s.s1.hint.1: Faɗaɗa furucin da aka bayar da kanka, ka duba ko ya yi daidai da na asali.
z-m-22-02.s.s1.st.0.info: x⁴ ya kai aƙalla 0, don haka x⁴+4 koyaushe ya kai aƙalla 4. Wato babu ainihin x da zai sa x⁴+4=0. Idan furucin linear x−k abu ne na ƙaruwa, ƙimar furucin dole ta zama 0 idan x=k, don haka babu linear factor mai ainihin coefficients.
z-m-22-02.s.s1.st.0.ask: Da bayanin da muke da shi yanzu kaɗai, ta yaya za ka yanke hukunci ko za a iya rubuta x⁴+4 a matsayin samfurin furuci biyu ko fiye masu ainihin coefficients?
z-m-22-02.s.s1.st.0.after: An tabbatar babu linear factor, amma har yanzu akwai yiwuwar samfurin furuci biyu na quadratic. A yanzu ya dace a riƙe hukuncinka ko a bar yiwuwar a buɗe.
z-m-22-02.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Ba za a iya rubuta shi ba. Babu linear factor, saboda haka ba ya rabuwa zuwa quadratic ma
z-m-22-02.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Ka tsallake daga gaskiyar babu linear factor zuwa 'babu samfur da zai yiwu'. Shin ka yi la'akari da yiwuwar samfurin furuci biyu na quadratic?
z-m-22-02.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Ba za a iya yanke hukunci ba tukuna. Yiwuwar ya rabu zuwa samfurin quadratic biyu tana nan.
z-m-22-02.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Ka bambanta rashin linear factor da rashin iya raba shi zuwa samfur.
z-m-22-02.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Ana iya rubuta shi. Idan an ƙara 4, koyaushe yana rabuwa
z-m-22-02.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Ba ya rabuwa saboda an ƙara 4 kawai. Kana buƙatar hujja.
z-m-22-02.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Ana iya rubuta shi. Duk furucin da ke da ƙarfin ma'aurata yana rabuwa
z-m-22-02.s.s1.st.0.r.d: x²+1 ma furuci ne mai ƙarfin ma'aurata, amma ba ya rabuwa zuwa linear expressions masu ainihin coefficients. Ka yi tunanin misalin da ke karyata wannan.
z-m-22-02.s.s1.st.1.info: Furuci mai kama da shi x⁴+5x²+4 ma ba shi da tushen ainihi saboda x⁴+5x²+4≥4. Amma idan ka ɗauki x² a matsayin A, to A²+5A+4=(A+1)(A+4), don haka x⁴+5x²+4 ana iya rubuta shi (x²+1)(x²+4).
z-m-22-02.s.s1.st.1.ask: Yaya za ka tantance furucin gama-gari na Jihu, 'idan babu tushen ainihi, ba za a iya rubuta shi a matsayin samfur ba'?
z-m-22-02.s.s1.st.1.after: x⁴+5x²+4 ba shi da tushen ainihi amma yana rabuwa zuwa (x²+1)(x²+4), don haka furucin gama-gari na Jihu ba daidai ba ne. Amma wannan bai tabbatar da cewa x⁴+4 yana rabuwa ba.
z-m-22-02.s.s1.st.1.o.a: An karyata furucin gama-gari. Amma ko x⁴+4 yana rabuwa dole ne a bincika dabam.
z-m-22-02.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Ka bambanta karyata furuci gama-gari da misali guda, da kuma batun ko wani takamaiman furuci ya rabu, wanda shi ne tambaya dabam.
z-m-22-02.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Yanzu tabbas za a iya rubuta x⁴+4 a matsayin samfur ma
z-m-22-02.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Misali guda da ke karyata furuci gama-gari ba ya tabbatar da cewa x⁴+4 yana rabuwa.
z-m-22-02.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Furucin Jihu har yanzu daidai ne. x⁴+5x²+4 wani furuci dabam ne.
z-m-22-02.s.s1.st.1.r.c: 'Idan babu tushen ainihi, ba ya rabuwa' furuci ne game da dukkan furuci; don haka wani furuci dabam guda ɗaya ya zama misali da ke karyata shi.
z-m-22-02.s.s1.st.1.o.d: An raba x⁴+5x²+4 ta maye gurbin x² da A, saboda haka ba za a iya amfani da shi a matsayin misalin karyatawa ba
z-m-22-02.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Faɗaɗa (x²+1)(x²+4) ka duba da kanka ko ya yi daidai da furucin asali.
z-m-22-02.s.s1.st.2.info: Idan ka ƙara sannan ka cire 4x² a x⁴+4, to x⁴+4=(x⁴+4x²+4)−4x²=(x²+2)²−(2x)².
z-m-22-02.s.s1.st.2.ask: Ta yaya za ka rubuta x⁴+4 da wannan sauyin?
z-m-22-02.s.s1.st.2.after: (x²+2)²−(2x)²=(x²+2−2x)(x²+2+2x)=(x²−2x+2)(x²+2x+2). Duba ko faɗaɗawa yana ba da x⁴+4. Ko ba shi da tushen ainihi, ana iya rubuta shi a matsayin samfurin quadratic biyu.
z-m-22-02.s.s1.st.2.o.a: (x²+2)²−(2x)² yana da ƙima dabam da x⁴+4, saboda haka ba za a iya amfani da shi ba
z-m-22-02.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Faɗaɗa (x²+2)² sannan ka cire 4x², ka lissafta ko ka samu x⁴+4.
z-m-22-02.s.s1.st.2.o.b: (x²+2)²−(2x)²=(x²+2)−(2x), saboda haka ya zama furucin quadratic guda
z-m-22-02.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Bambancin murabba'ai shi ne (A−B)(A+B), ba ya zama furuci guda A−B.
z-m-22-02.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Ya zama samfurin furuci quadratic biyu, (x²−2x+2)(x²+2x+2)
z-m-22-02.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Ka koyi hanyar sauya bambancin murabba'ai biyu zuwa samfur.
z-m-22-02.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Bambancin murabba'ai ne, saboda haka ba ya ƙara rabuwa a cikin lambobin ainihi
z-m-22-02.s.s1.st.2.r.d: A²−B²=(A−B)(A+B) yana aiki ga kowane furuci A da B.
z-m-22-02.s.s1.reflect: Da farko, gaskiyar cewa babu linear factor ba ta isa a yanke hukunci ba. Yayin da misalin karyatawa da takamaiman sauyi suka bayyana, hukuncin ya tabbata. Idan da farko ka yi hasashen 'ba ya rabuwa', ka faɗi wane sabon bayani ya canza tunaninka.
z-m-22-02.s.s2.prompt: Mu ƙirƙiri furuci x⁴+c² da wannan hanyar x⁴+4 ke aiki a kansu, cikin coefficients cikakku. Idan aka sake rubuta x⁴+c² a sigar (x²+c)²−(dx)², wace dangantaka ce dole ta kasance tsakanin c da d? Nemo nau'i biyu dabam inda c da d lambobin halitta ne kuma c aƙalla 3 ne.
z-m-22-02.s.s2.hint.0: Faɗaɗa (x²+c)² ka kwatanta term ɗin da ya bambanta da x⁴+c².
z-m-22-02.s.s2.hint.1: Ka yi tunanin wane lamba ya kamata ya zama murabba'in term ɗin da ya rage, sannan bayan zaɓar d ka lissafta c.
z-m-22-02.s.s2.ok.c1: c aƙalla 3 ne kuma d lamba ce ta halitta.
z-m-22-02.s.s2.fail.c1: c dole ya kai aƙalla 3 kuma d ya kai aƙalla 1.
z-m-22-02.s.s2.ok.c2: c da d lambobi cikakku ne.
z-m-22-02.s.s2.fail.c2: c da d dole su zama lambobi cikakku.
z-m-22-02.s.s2.fail.c3: (x²+c)²=x⁴+2cx²+c², don haka (dx)² da 2cx² dole su yi daidai. Kwatanta d² da 2c.
z-m-22-02.s.s2.explain: x⁴+c²=(x²+c)²−2cx², saboda haka idan 2c murabba'in lamba cikakkiya d² ce, yana rabuwa zuwa (x²−dx+c)(x²+dx+c). (c, d)=(8, 4) yana ba da x⁴+64=(x²−4x+8)(x²+4x+8), (18, 6) yana ba da x⁴+324=(x²−6x+18)(x²+6x+18), kuma (32, 8) yana ba da x⁴+1024=(x²−8x+32)(x²+8x+32). Idan an yarda da ainihin coefficients, yana rabuwa ga kowane c mai kyau da d=√(2c); idan an takaita zuwa lambobi cikakku, irin wannan dangantaka ake buƙata.

z-m-22-03.title: Me kuma za mu iya koya daga gaskiyar cewa saura sun yi daidai?
z-m-22-03.topic: Amfani da ka'idar saura (saura daga furuci linear da dama)
z-m-22-03.goal: Yi aiki da yadda hukuncin saura yayin rabawa da furucin quadratic yake canzawa, yayin da ake ƙara bayanan saura ɗaya bayan ɗaya, sannan ka ƙirƙiri furuci da dama da suka cika sharuddan iri ɗaya.
z-m-22-03.material: f(x) polynomial ne mai ainihin coefficients kuma ba a san matsayinsa ba. Ana rubuta rabawar polynomial a sigar f(x)=(mai rabawa)·(quotient)+(saura), kuma matsayin saura ya fi na mai rabawa ƙasa. Yayin da bayanai ke bayyana ɗaya bayan ɗaya, mu duba abin da za a iya faɗi game da saura idan an raba f(x) da (x−1)(x−2).

z-m-22-03.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Akwai furuci da yawa banda 4x waɗanda ƙimarsu 4 ce idan x=1. [Lambobi: 4, 4, 1].
z-m-22-03.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Ba shi da alaƙa da x−1, ba za a iya cewa komai ba. [Lambobi: 1].
z-m-22-03.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Akwai sharadi tuni cewa ragowar 4 ce idan x=1. Ba wai ba ka san komai ba. [Lambobi: 4, 1].

z-m-22-03.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Ƙimar 6 ce idan x=1, ba ta cika Bayani na 1 ba. [Lambobi: 6, 1, 1].
z-m-22-03.s.s1.st.2.info: Bayani na 3: Ragowar raba f(x) da x−3 ita ce 5. (Misali f(x)=½x²−(3/2)x+5 yana cika bayanai 1,2,3.) [Lambobi: 3, 3, 5, 3, 2, 5, 1, 2, 3].
z-m-22-03.s.s1.st.2.ask: Idan aka ƙara wannan bayani, ragowar raba da (x−1)(x−2) za ta canza? [Lambobi: 1, 2].
z-m-22-03.s.s1.st.2.after: Ga misalin f(x)=½x²−(3/2)x+5, f(x)−4=½(x−1)(x−2), saboda haka ragowar raba da (x−1)(x−2) har yanzu 4 ce. Bayani na 3 ya shafi wani wuri, f(3)=5. [Lambobi: 3, 2, 5, 4, 1, 2, 1, 2, 4, 3, 3, 5].
z-m-22-03.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Ba ta canza. Bayani na 3 ya shafi x=3 kawai. [Lambobi: 3, 3].
z-m-22-03.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Ka gane cewa bayanai 1 da 2 sun riga sun ƙayyade ragowar, Bayani na 3 kuma ya shafi wani wuri. [Lambobi: 1, 2, 3].
z-m-22-03.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Ta canza ta zama 5. Sabon bayani ya maye gurbin wanda aka koya da farko. [Lambobi: 5].
z-m-22-03.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Kana ɗaukar sabon bayani kamar yana share na baya. Shin tsoffin bayanan suna nan gaskiya? [Lambobi: ].
z-m-22-03.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Ta canza zuwa ƙima tsakanin 4 da 5, domin sabon bayanin ya gauraya da bayanan da ake da su. [Lambobi: 4, 5].
z-m-22-03.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Gwada da furucin misali ko ragowar tana gauraya kamar matsakaicin wasu ƙimomi. [Lambobi: ].
z-m-22-03.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Bayanai 1 zuwa 3 sun saɓa, babu f(x) da ke cika sharuddan. [Lambobi: 1, 3].
z-m-22-03.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Saka 1,2,3 cikin f(x) na misali ka duba ko bayanai ukun gaskiya ne. [Lambobi: 1, 2, 3].
z-m-22-03.s.s1.reflect: Da Bayani na 1 ba ka iya ƙayyade ragowar; da aka ƙara na 2 ta tabbata; na 3 kuma bai canza abin da ya riga ya tabbata ba. Ka bambanta lokacin da sabon bayani ke sauya hukunci da wanda ba ya sauyawa. [Lambobi: 1, 2, 3].
z-m-22-03.s.s2.prompt: Ƙirƙiri furuci uku mabambanta f(x)=ax²+bx+c waɗanda suka cika f(1)=4 da f(2)=4. (a=0 ma yana yiwuwa.) [Lambobi: 1, 4, 2, 4, 0].
z-m-22-03.s.s2.hint.0: Rubuta f(1) da f(2) ta amfani da a,b,c domin samun daidaito biyu. [Lambobi: 1, 2].
z-m-22-03.s.s2.hint.1: Zaɓi ƙimar harafi ɗaya, misali a, ka tabbatar sauran biyun sun biyo baya. [Lambobi: ].
z-m-22-03.s.s2.fail.c1: Ƙimar a+b+c daga saka x=1 ba 4 ba ce. [Lambobi: 1, 4].
z-m-22-03.s.s2.fail.c2: Ƙimar 4a+2b+c daga saka x=2 ba 4 ba ce. [Lambobi: 4, 2, 2, 4].
z-m-22-03.s.s2.explain: Daga sharuɗɗan biyu, b=−3a kuma c=4+2a; kowane zaɓin a yana samar da ɗaya. Misali (1,−3,6) shi ne x²−3x+6; (2,−6,8) shi ne 2x²−6x+8; (−1,3,2) shi ne −x²+3x+2; (0,0,4) kuma lamba tsayayyiya 4 ce. Dukkansu suna da f(x)−4=a(x−1)(x−2), saboda haka ragowar raba da (x−1)(x−2) ita ce 4. [Lambobi: 3, 4, 2, 1, 3, 6, 3, 6, 2, 6, 8, 2, 6, 8, 1, 3, 2, 3, 2, 0, 0, 4, 4, 4, 1, 2, 1, 2, 4].
z-m-22-03.s.s2.because.prompt: Idan f(1)=f(2)=4, bayyana dalilin da ya sa ragowar raba da (x−1)(x−2) take 4 a duk misalan ukun. [Lambobi: 1, 2, 4, 1, 2, 4].
z-m-22-03.s.s2.because.hint.0: Da farko lissafta ka rubuta f(1) da f(2) ga kowane furuci ukun. [Lambobi: 1, 2].
z-m-22-03.s.s2.because.hint.1: Yi tunanin wace lamba za ka cire daga f(x) domin ya zama 0 a x=1 da x=2. [Lambobi: 0, 1, 2].
z-m-22-03.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ka yi amfani da cewa f(x)−4 ya zama 0 idan x=1 da x=2? [Lambobi: 4, 0, 1, 2].
z-m-22-03.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ka ci gaba zuwa hukuncin cewa ragowar lamba tsayayyiya 4 ce? [Lambobi: 4].
z-m-22-03.s.s2.because.model.0: Tun da f(1)=f(2)=4, f(x)−4 ya zama 0 a x=1 da x=2. Saboda haka yana rabuwa da (x−1)(x−2), kuma f(x)=(x−1)(x−2)×rabo+4; ragowar 4 ce. [Lambobi: 1, 2, 4, 4, 0, 1, 2, 1, 2, 1, 2, 4, 4].
z-m-22-03.s.s2.because.model.1: A duk furuci ukun f(1)=f(2)=4; idan muka cire 4, 1 da 2 sun zama tushen, kuma (x−1)(x−2) mai ninkawa ne na f(x)−4. Saboda haka ragowar 4 ce. [Lambobi: 1, 2, 4, 4, 1, 2, 1, 2, 4, 4].
z-m-22-03.s.s2.because.model.2: Idan na rubuta ragowar px+q, to p+q=4 da 2p+q=4, saboda haka p=0,q=4. Ragowar lamba tsayayyiya 4 ce. [Lambobi: 4, 2, 4, 0, 4, 4].

z-m-22-05.thinking.2: Yin misalan da suka gamsar da sharuɗɗan
z-m-22-05.prereq.1: Ma'anar matsayi da term mafi girman matsayi na polynomial
z-m-22-05.prereq.0: H3 a wannan aiki matakin wahala ne na wannan rukuni kawai, ba matakin aji ba ne. A ɗauka ka riga ka koyi sashen polynomial na Common Math na makarantar sakandare (aiki huɗu, daidaiton rabawa da warware ƙaƙƙarfan ƙima).
z-m-22-05.title: Idan digiri kawai aka sani, shin digirin furuci biyu na polynomials tabbatacce ne? [Lambobi: ].
z-m-22-05.goal: Yi amfani da sharuɗɗa biyu na digirin ninkawa da jimilla domin nemo digirin polynomials biyu, sannan tabbatar da misalai rawar ma'aunin kalmar mafi girman digiri idan sharadi ya canza. [Lambobi: ].
z-m-22-05.material: f(x) da g(x) polynomials ne marasa sifili masu ma'aunai na gaske. An san bayanai biyu: (1) Digirin f(x)g(x) shi ne 6. (2) Digirin f(x)+g(x) shi ne 3. Digiri shi ne ma'aunin babban iko cikin kalmomin da ba sifili ba. Lamba tsayayyiya marar sifili tana da digiri 0. Bari mu duba ko bayanan sun ƙayyade digirin f da g, da abin da zai faru idan bayanin ya canza. [Lambobi: 1, 6, 2, 3, 0].
z-m-22-05.thinking.0: Tsara zaɓuɓɓuka da dama bisa tsari [Lambobi: ].
z-m-22-05.prereq.2: Kwarewa wajen fahimtar yadda ake tantance kalmar mafi girman digiri a jimilla da ninkar polynomials biyu [Lambobi: ].
z-m-22-05.s.s1.prompt: f(x) da g(x) polynomials ne marasa sifili masu ma'aunai na gaske. Shin bayanan cewa digirin ninkawar f(x)g(x) shi ne 6, kuma digirin jimillar f(x)+g(x) shi ne 3 kaɗai sun isa ƙayyade digirinsu? [Lambobi: 6, 3].
z-m-22-05.s.s1.hint.0: Rubuta duk ma'auratan digiri biyu waɗanda jimillarsu 6, kamar (6,0),(5,1),(4,2),(3,3). [Lambobi: 6, 6, 0, 5, 1, 4, 2, 3, 3].
z-m-22-05.s.s1.hint.1: Ga kowane ma'aurata, duba ɗaya bayan ɗaya digirin f(x)+g(x). [Lambobi: ].
z-m-22-05.s.s1.o.a: Ɗaya digiri 6 ne, ɗayan kuma lamba tsayayyiya mai digiri 0, domin ninkawar na da digiri 6. [Lambobi: 6, 0, 6].
z-m-22-05.s.s1.r.a: Ka yi amfani da digirin ninkawa 6 kawai, ba digirin jimilla 3 ba. Duba digirin jimillar (digiri 6, digiri 0). [Lambobi: 6, 3, 6, 0].
z-m-22-05.s.s1.o.b: Ba za a iya ƙayyade ba. Akwai ma'aurata da dama masu ninkawa digiri 6, kamar (4,2) ko (5,1). [Lambobi: 6, 4, 2, 5, 1].
z-m-22-05.s.s1.r.b: Akwai ma'aurata da dama masu ninkawa digiri 6, amma ka tace ta sharadin jimillar tana da digiri 3? [Lambobi: 6, 3].
z-m-22-05.s.s1.o.c: Ɗaya digiri 3 ne, ɗayan kuma yana da digiri ƙasa da 3, domin jimillar digiri 3 ce. [Lambobi: 3, 3, 3].
z-m-22-05.s.s1.r.c: Ka yi amfani da digirin jimilla 3 kawai, ba ninkawa digiri 6 ba. Duba digirin ninkar furuci mai digiri 3 da wani mai ƙaramin digiri. [Lambobi: 3, 6, 3].
z-m-22-05.s.s1.o.d: Dukansu digiri 3 ne. Sauran ma'auratan ba za su ba da jimilla mai digiri 3 ba. [Lambobi: 3, 3].
z-m-22-05.s.s1.r.d: Ka tace zaɓuɓɓukan ta amfani da sharuɗɗan biyu: digirin ninkawa da digirin jimilla. [Lambobi: ].
z-m-22-05.s.s1.explain: Ninkawar tana da digiri 6, don haka jimillar digirin 6 ce. Idan digirin biyu mabambanta ne, jimillar tana da digirin mafi girma (4 ko fiye), ba za ta zama 3 ba. Saboda haka digirinsu iri ɗaya ne kuma duka 3. [Lambobi: 6, 6, 4, 3, 3].
z-m-22-05.s.s2.prompt: Mu ƙirƙiri f(x) da g(x) waɗanda ninkawarsu digiri 6, jimillarsu digiri 3 ne, ta rubuta kalmomin babban digiri kawai. Digirin f ya zama m mai ma'auni p, na g ya zama n mai ma'auni q. Nemo misalai biyu mabambanta. (Musanya f da g misali guda ne.) [Lambobi: 6, 3].
z-m-22-05.s.s2.hint.0: Da farko zaɓi ma'auratan digiri masu jimilla 6, sannan nemo digirin jimillar. [Lambobi: 6].
z-m-22-05.s.s2.hint.1: Duba abin da ke faruwa idan digirinsu ɗaya ne kuma aka haɗa ma'aunan kalmomin babban digiri. [Lambobi: ].
z-m-22-05.s.s2.var.p: Ma'aunin p na kalmar mafi girman digiri ta f [Lambobi: ].
z-m-22-05.s.s2.var.q: Ma'aunin q na kalmar mafi girman digiri ta g [Lambobi: ].
z-m-22-05.s.s2.fail.c1: Digirorin dole su zama cikakkun lambobi aƙalla 0. [Lambobi: 0].
z-m-22-05.s.s2.ok.c2: Ma'aunan kalmomin mafi girman digiri ba sifili ba ne. [Lambobi: 0].
z-m-22-05.s.s2.fail.c2: Ma'aunan kalmomin mafi girman digiri ba za su zama sifili ba. [Lambobi: 0].
z-m-22-05.s.s2.fail.c3: Digirin ninkawa jimillar digirorin biyu ne. m+n ba 6 ba ne. [Lambobi: 6].
z-m-22-05.s.s2.fail.c4: Digirin jimilla ba 3 ba ne. Duba ko kalmar babban digiri ba ta ɓace ba idan digirorin iri ɗaya ne, da kuma wanne ne mafi girma idan sun bambanta. [Lambobi: 3].
z-m-22-05.s.s2.explain: Dole digirorin biyu su zama 3, kuma ma'aunan p da q na kalmomin mafi girman digiri ba sifili ba ne, p+q kuma ba 0 ba ne domin jimillar ta riƙe digiri 3. Misali p=q=1, f=x³+…, g=x³+…, jimilla 2x³+… ce. Idan p=1,q=−1, kalmar babban digiri ta soke, jimillar kuma digiri ƙasa da 3 take da shi. [Lambobi: 3, 0, 3, 1, 2, 1, 1, 3].
z-m-22-05.s.s3.prompt: Sharadin ya canza. Digirin ninkawa har yanzu 6 ne, amma an ce digirin jimillar f(x)+g(x) shi ne 2. Yaya digirin polynomials biyu zai kasance? [Lambobi: 6, 2].
z-m-22-05.s.s3.hint.0: Duba yadda kalmar mafi girman digiri ke kasancewa a jimillar polynomials biyu masu digiri mabambanta. [Lambobi: ].
z-m-22-05.s.s3.hint.1: Ƙirƙiri misali guda ka duba digirin ninkawa da jimilla da kanka. [Lambobi: ].
z-m-22-05.s.s3.o.a: (4, 2) ko (2, 4). Jimillar tana da daraja 2, saboda haka ƙaramin darajar daga cikin biyun tana da daraja 2
z-m-22-05.s.s3.r.a: Idan darajojin sun bambanta, darajar jimillar za ta zama mafi girma (4). Jimillar ba za ta iya zama daraja 2 ba.
z-m-22-05.s.s3.o.b: Dukkansu daraja 3 ne, kuma jimillar ma'aunansu 0 ce, saboda haka kalmomin daraja mafi girma biyu sun soke juna
z-m-22-05.s.s3.r.b: Ka yi amfani da gaskiyar cewa kalmar daraja mafi girma tana iya ɓacewa ne kawai idan darajojin sun yi daidai.
z-m-22-05.s.s3.o.c: Dukkansu daraja 3 ne, kuma jimillar ma'aunan kalmomin daraja mafi girma ba 0 ba ce
z-m-22-05.s.s3.r.c: Idan kalmar daraja mafi girma ta rage, jimillar tana da daraja 3. Ka yi tunanin abin da dole ya faru domin jimillar ta zama daraja 2.
z-m-22-05.s.s3.o.d: Babu f(x) da g(x) da suka cika waɗannan sharuɗɗan
z-m-22-05.s.s3.r.d: Ka bincika kai tsaye da misali, kamar f=x³+x², g=−x³+x.
z-m-22-05.s.s3.explain: Idan darajojin sun bambanta, darajar jimillar ita ce mafi girma (4 ko fiye), ba za ta zama 2 ba. Saboda haka duka dole su zama daraja 3 kuma kalmomin daraja mafi girma su soke juna. Misali, idan f=x³+x², g=−x³+x, ninkar tana da daraja 6, jimillar kuma x²+x ce mai daraja 2.

z-m-22-06.prereq.0: H3 a wannan aiki matakin wahala ne na wannan rukuni kawai, ba matakin aji ba ne. A ɗauka ka riga ka koyi sashen polynomial na Common Math na makarantar sakandare (aiki huɗu, daidaiton rabawa da warware ƙaƙƙarfan ƙima).
z-m-22-06.title: Lokacin da akwai sharuɗɗa biyu amma har yanzu ba a kayyade a da b ba
z-m-22-06.topic: Ka'idar mai rabo da kayyade ma'aunai (yancin bayanai)
z-m-22-06.goal: Ka yanke shawarar ko ba a sani ba sun kayyadu bisa yawan bayanai masu zaman kansu, ba yawan sharuɗɗa kawai ba; sannan ka ware sharuɗɗan da suke faɗin abu ɗaya ta wata hanya ko waɗanda koyaushe gaskiya ne.
z-m-22-06.material: f(x)=x³+ax²+bx−6, inda a da b tsayayyun lambobi na ainihi ne. Furucin ‘saura idan an raba da furuci mai layi 0 ne’ da furucin ‘wannan furuci mai layi mai rabon f(x) ne’ suna nufin abu ɗaya. Mu duba ko sanannun bayanai game da f(x) suna kayyade a da b a matsayin ma’aurata.
z-m-22-06.thinking.1: Bambance bayanai iri ɗaya da sababbin bayanai
z-m-22-06.thinking.2: Karyata ikirari da misalan ƙaryatawa (ma'aurata da dama)
z-m-22-06.prereq.1: Sanin cewa idan saura idan aka raba furucin aljabara da furuci mai layi ya zama 0, to furucin mai layi mai rabon furucin aljabara ne (yana raba shi babu saura)
z-m-22-06.prereq.2: Kwarewar sharuɗɗan da ke kayyade mafitar tsarin ma'aunai ta zama guda ɗaya
z-m-22-06.s.s1.prompt: Ga f(x)=x³+ax²+bx−6 (a da b lambobi na ainihi ne), nemo ma'aurata daban-daban guda 3 na (a, b) da ke sa x−1 ya zama mai rabo na f(x).
z-m-22-06.s.s1.hint.0: Da farko ka yanke shawarar ƙimar x da ke sa x−1 ya zama 0, sannan ka rubuta abin da f dole ta zama a wannan ƙimar.
z-m-22-06.s.s1.hint.1: Ka rubuta ma'auratan da ka samo a tebur, sannan ka duba ƙa'idar da ke tsakanin lambobin biyun.
z-m-22-06.s.s1.ok.c1: Ƙimar f idan x=1 ita ce 0.
z-m-22-06.s.s1.fail.c1: Idan x−1 mai rabo ne, ƙimar 1+a+b−6 da aka samu ta saka x=1 dole ta zama 0.
z-m-22-06.s.s1.explain: Idan x−1 mai rabo ne, to f(1)=1+a+b−6=0, saboda haka a+b=5. Akwai ma'aurata masu jimillar 5 da yawa, kamar (0, 5), (1, 4), (−1, 6), (2, 3). Sharaɗi guda ɗaya ba ya kayyade a da b su zama ma'aurata guda ɗaya.
z-m-22-06.s.s2.prompt: f(x)=x³+ax²+bx−6. Zaɓi duk rukunin bayanan da ke ƙasa waɗanda suke kayyade (a, b) ya zama ma'aurata guda ɗaya bisa waɗannan bayanai kawai.
z-m-22-06.s.s2.hint.0: Ga kowane rukuni, sake rubuta bayanan biyun a matsayin ma'aunai masu fasalin ‘f(wata lamba)=ƙima’.
z-m-22-06.s.s2.hint.1: Ka kwatanta ko ma'aunai biyun bayanai ne daban-daban ko kuwa ɗaya yana biyo kai tsaye daga ɗayan.
z-m-22-06.s.s2.o.a: x−1 mai rabo ne na f(x). x=1 mafita ce ta ma'aunin f(x)=0.
z-m-22-06.s.s2.r.a: Ka kwatanta ko jimlolin biyun gaskiya ɗaya suke faɗi kuwa? Idan abu ɗaya suke nufi, ma'auni guda ɗaya kawai ake samu.
z-m-22-06.s.s2.r.b: Waɗannan ƙimomi ne a wurare biyu daban, saboda haka ana samun ma'aunai biyu masu zaman kansu game da a da b.
z-m-22-06.s.s2.o.c: f(0)=−6. x−1 mai rabo ne na f(x).
z-m-22-06.s.s2.r.c: Ka rubuta kai tsaye ma'aunin a da b da f(0) yake bayarwa.
z-m-22-06.s.s2.o.d: Duk x−1 da x+1 masu rabo ne na f(x).
z-m-22-06.s.s2.r.d: Ka lura cewa ana samun ma'aunai biyu da ke cewa ƙimomi a x=1 da x=−1 duk 0 ne.
z-m-22-06.s.s2.o.e: x−1 mai rabo ne na f(x). Saura idan aka raba f(x) da x+2 ita ce −6.
z-m-22-06.s.s2.r.e: Saura idan aka raba da x+2 ita ce f(−2). Bayani ne daga wani wuri dabam da x=1, wato x=−2, saboda haka yana samar da ma'aunai biyu masu zaman kansu, a+b=5 da 2a−b=4.
z-m-22-06.s.s2.explain: a: Jimlolin biyun duk suna cewa f(1)=0, saboda haka ma'auni guda ɗaya ne kawai. c: f(0)=−6 shi ne adadin tsayayye −6 na furucin, saboda haka gaskiya ne koyaushe ko wane ne a da b; ba sabon bayani ba ne, f(1)=0 kaɗai ya rage. b: a+b=5, 2a+b=−1 → (a, b)=(−6, 11). d: a+b=5, a−b=7 → (6, −1). e: daga f(1)=0, f(−2)=−6, a+b=5, 2a−b=4 → (3, 2).
z-m-22-06.s.s3.prompt: Wani aboki ya ce, ‘Akwai sharaɗin cewa x−1 mai rabo ne, sannan akwai sharaɗin cewa babban ma'aunin rabon da ake samu idan aka raba f(x) da x−1 shi ne 1; saboda haka sharuɗɗa biyu ne, kuma an kayyade a da b.’ Ka rubuta ra'ayinka game da wannan ikirari tare da dalilai.
z-m-22-06.s.s3.hint.0: Ka rubuta f(x)=(x−1)(rabon), ka kwatanta sharuɗɗan x³ a ɓangarorin biyu, sannan ka rubuta kalmar farko ta rabon.
z-m-22-06.s.s3.hint.1: Ka bincika ko sakamakon ya danganta da ƙimomin a da b, sannan ka danganta da sakamakon s1 yawan ma'auratan (a, b) da suke rage idan sharaɗin kawai shi ne x−1 mai rabo.
z-m-22-06.s.s3.placeholder: misali, Kalmar farko ta rabon ita ce ...
z-m-22-06.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ka rubuta a wane ɓangare na furucin aka riga aka san cewa babban ma'aunin rabon 1 ne kuwa?
z-m-22-06.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ka rubuta yawan sharuɗɗan da suka rage a zahiri a sakamakon kuwa?
z-m-22-06.s.s3.model.0: f(x) yana farawa da x³, saboda haka rabon da aka samu idan aka raba shi da x−1 koyaushe yana farawa da x², kuma babban ma'auninsa koyaushe 1 ne ko wane ne a da b. Ba sabon bayani ba ne, a zahiri sharaɗi guda ne kawai: x−1 mai rabo ne.
z-m-22-06.s.s3.model.1: Babban ma'aunin rabon koyaushe 1 ne domin ma'aunin x³ a f(x) tuni 1 ne. Wannan ba bayani ne game da a da b ba, saboda haka ma'auratan da ke cika a+b=5 suna nan daram.

z-m-22-13.prereq.0: H3 a wannan aiki matakin wahala ne na wannan rukuni kawai, ba matakin aji ba ne. A ɗauka ka riga ka koyi sashen polynomial na Common Math na makarantar sakandare (aiki huɗu, daidaiton rabawa da warware ƙaƙƙarfan ƙima).

z-m-22-13.topic: Coefficients na polynomial da ƙimomin da ake samu idan an saka lambobi
z-m-22-13.goal: Ka tantance dangantakar coefficients da za ka iya sani ko ba za ka iya sani ba daga ƙimomin da aka samu ta saka lambobi, ka ƙirƙiri furucinka da suka cika dangantakar, sannan ka bayyana dalili cikin sauƙin kalmomi.
z-m-22-13.material: Idan ka faɗaɗa f(x)=(2x−1)⁵, terms daga x⁵ zuwa constant term za su fito. Ka kira coefficient na kowane term c5, c4, c3, c2, c1, c0 (c5 coefficient na x⁵ ne, c0 kuma constant term). A wannan aiki, ba tare da faɗaɗawa ba, muna tunanin abin da za mu iya sani da wanda ba za mu iya sani ba daga ƙimomin da aka samu ta saka x=0, 1, −1 kawai. Ana karanta (2x−1)⁵ da '2x a debe 1, zuwa ƙarfin biyar.'

z-m-22-13.s.s1.prompt: A ce ka faɗaɗa f(x)=(2x−1)⁵ ka rubuta f(x)=c5x⁵+c4x⁴+c3x³+c2x²+c1x+c0. Zaɓi duk abin da za ka iya nemo ta ƙimomin x=0, 1, −1 kawai ba tare da faɗaɗawa ba.
z-m-22-13.s.s1.hint.0: Rubuta yadda sifar faɗaɗa ta f(x) take sauƙaƙa idan ka saka x=0, 1, −1.
z-m-22-13.s.s1.hint.1: Duba terms da suke ɓacewa idan ka tara ko ka rage sakamakon x=1 da x=−1.
z-m-22-13.s.s1.r.a: Ka lura cewa idan ka saka x=1, kowace ƙarfi ta x a kowane term tana zama 1.
z-m-22-13.s.s1.r.b: Tare da ƙimomi uku 0, 1, −1 ba za ka iya ware coefficient guda ɗaya daga cikin shida ba. Ƙirga adadin ma'aunai da za ka iya samu.
z-m-22-13.s.s1.o.c: Jimillar coefficients na terms masu matsayi marar ma'aurata c5+c3+c1
z-m-22-13.s.s1.r.c: Ka lura cewa idan ka cire ƙimar x=−1 daga ta x=1, terms masu matsayi ma'aurata suna ɓacewa.
z-m-22-13.s.s1.r.d: Ka danganta gaskiyar cewa alamun ma'aunan (2x−1)⁵ suna canzawa a jere da darajar idan x=−1.
z-m-22-13.s.s1.r.e: Ba za ka iya gano c4 shi kaɗai daga ƴan darajoji da aka saka wa x ba. Kwatanta yawan ma'aunan da ka samu da yawan abubuwan da ba a sani ba.
z-m-22-13.s.s1.explain: A x=1, f(1)=c5+…+c0=(2−1)⁵=1, kuma a x=−1, f(−1)=−c5+c4−c3+c2−c1+c0=(−3)⁵=−243. Jimillar ma'aunan masu digiri marasa-miji ita ce (f(1)−f(−1))/2=122. Alamun ma'aunan suna canzawa (32, −80, 80, −40, 10, −1), saboda haka jimillar cikakkun darajojinsu ita ce |f(−1)|=243. Ba za a iya gano c3 ko c4 ɗaiɗai ba.
z-m-22-13.s.s1.acc.0: An zaɓi a da c daidai. Don d kuma kana buƙatar sanin cewa alamun ma'aunan suna canzawa a jere, saboda haka yana buƙatar ƙarin tunani.
z-m-22-13.s.s2.prompt: Ga furucin kubik f(x)=x³+ax²+bx+c, ƙirƙiri furuci uku mabambanta waɗanda jimillar ma'aunansu 0 ce, kuma jimillar ma'aunan kalmomin masu digiri marasa-miji (x³, x) ma 0 ce.
z-m-22-13.s.s2.hint.0: Rubuta jimillar ma'aunan duka da jimillar ma'aunan kalmomin masu digiri marasa-miji kowannensu a matsayin ma'auni a cikin a, b, c.
z-m-22-13.s.s2.hint.1: Da farko zaɓi harafi ɗaya ka nemo sauran.
z-m-22-13.s.s2.ok.c2: Jimillar ma'aunan kalmomin masu digiri marasa-miji 0 ce.
z-m-22-13.s.s2.fail.c2: Jimillar 1+b ta ma'aunan kalmomin masu digiri marasa-miji (x³, x) ba 0 ba ce.
z-m-22-13.s.s2.explain: b=−1 kuma c=−a. Misalai: idan a=0, x³−x; idan a=1, x³+x²−x−1; idan a=2, x³+2x²−x−2. Waɗannan furuci suna da f(1)=0 da f(−1)=0, saboda haka dukkansu suna da (x−1)(x+1) a matsayin ma'auni, kuma x³+ax²−x−a=(x−1)(x+1)(x+a).
z-m-22-13.s.s3.prompt: Ƙaninka ko ƙanwarka a aji na 3 na makarantar tsakiya ya tambaye ka, “Ba ka ma buɗe (2x−1)⁵ ba, to ta yaya ka san jimillar ma'aunan?” Ka bayyana yadda zai fahimta.

z-m-22-01.title: Me ya rage idan aka raba x zuwa ƙarfin 2026 da x²−1?
z-m-22-01.goal: Ta amfani da ƙimomin da ke sa mai rabawa ya zama 0, tabbatar da dalilin da ya sa ƙa'idar saura da aka hango daga wasu misalai ke aiki ga manyan ƙarfi ma, sannan ka yi amfani da ita wajen rabawa da wani furucin quadratic.
z-m-22-01.material: Idan aka raba xⁿ (furucin da ke ninka x da kansa n sau, inda n lamba ce ta halitta) da x²−1, ana iya rubuta xⁿ=(x²−1)Q(x)+R(x), kuma saura R(x) furuci ne mai matsayi bai wuce 1 ba (har da constants). Yayin da muke duba sakamakon n=1, 2, 3, ... ɗaya bayan ɗaya, mu yi tunani game da saura idan n=2026. 'x zuwa ƙarfin 2026' yana nufin ninka x da kansa sau 2026.

z-m-22-01.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Ka yi amfani da daidaitattun hujjojin biyu wajen nemo a da b.

z-m-22-12.s.s1.prompt: Akwai mafita uku na x⁴−4. Mafita ①: (x²−2)(x²+2). Mafita ②: (x−√2)(x+√2)(x²+2). Mafita ③: (x−√2)(x+√2)(x−√2i)(x+√2i). Zaɓi duk furucin daidai. (i ita ce imaginary unit kuma i²=−1.)
z-m-22-12.s.s1.hint.0: Faɗaɗa abubuwan kowane mafita ka duba ko ka samu x⁴−4.
z-m-22-12.s.s1.hint.1: Ka yi tunani ɗaya bayan ɗaya ko kowane factor yana ƙara rabuwa a wannan zangon.
z-m-22-12.s.s1.o.a: Idan coefficients an takaita su zuwa lambobi cikakku, mafita ① ba ta ƙara rabuwa.
z-m-22-12.s.s1.r.a: Ka san cewa 'ƙarshe' yana dogara da zangon coefficients da aka yi amfani da shi.
z-m-22-12.s.s1.o.b: Idan an yarda da coefficients na ainihi, mafita ① ba ta gama warwarewa ba.
z-m-22-12.s.s1.r.b: Ka lura cewa a lambobin ainihi, x²−2 yana rabuwa zuwa furuci linear biyu.
z-m-22-12.s.s1.o.c: x²+2 yana rabuwa zuwa (x−√2)(x+√2) a lambobin ainihi.
z-m-22-12.s.s1.r.c: Faɗaɗa (x−√2)(x+√2) yana ba da x²−2. Duba ko daidai yake da x²+2.
z-m-22-12.s.s1.o.d: Duk zangon coefficients da aka zaɓa, mafita ① ita ce warwarewa ta ƙarshe.
z-m-22-12.s.s1.r.d: Akwai furuci da za a iya ƙara raba su idan zangon coefficients ya faɗaɗa.
z-m-22-12.s.s1.o.e: Idan an yarda da lambobin hadaddun, x²+2 ma yana rabuwa zuwa samfurin furuci linear biyu.
z-m-22-12.s.s1.r.e: Ka lura cewa mafita na x²+2=0 ƙimomi imaginary ne, saboda haka a lambobin hadaddun yana rabuwa zuwa furuci linear.
z-m-22-12.s.s1.explain: 'Ƙarshe' a warwarewar ƙaƙƙarfan ƙima ya dogara da zangon coefficients. A lambobi cikakku shi ne (x²−2)(x²+2), a lambobi ainihi shi ne (x−√2)(x+√2)(x²+2), a hadaddun kuma samfurin furuci linear huɗu ne. x²+2 ba ya ƙara rabuwa a ainihi, kuma (x−√2)(x+√2)=x²−2.
